create_rabitq_fastscan_index: create a RaBitQFastScan index for fast approximate nearest neighbor search with configurable bit width
create_ivf_rabitq_fastscan_index: create an IVF RaBitQFastScan index with inverted file clustering for large-scale vector search
test_rabitq_fastscan_recall: test that RaBitQFastScan recall improves monotonically as the number of quantization bits increases
test_rabitq_fastscan_serialization: test that serializing and deserializing a RaBitQFastScan index preserves identical search results
test_rabitq_fastscan_filtering: test IVF RaBitQFastScan search with IDSelectorBatch filters to exclude specific vector IDs from results
